visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with long dark hair, wearing a black motorcycle helmet and a grey patterned hooded sweater, stands in front of a retail display rack filled with small, colorful toy packets. He points at a pink packet. The background shows a bright, cluttered store environment with red tassels hanging from the ceiling. (2) Close-up shot of the pink packet being held. It features a cartoon Christmas tree and Santa Claus, labeled with Chinese text. (3) On a metal countertop under bright indoor lighting, the man's hands remove the contents of the packet: two white cardboard tree cutouts, a black plastic base, and a small sachet of clear liquid. (4) The man assembles the cardboard pieces into a 3D tree shape and places it into the black base. He then tears open the liquid sachet and pours it over the top of the tree. (5) A series of shots shows the cardboard tree developing colorful, fluffy crystals. The branches gradually fill with white, yellow, and green crystalline growths. (6) The final product, a fully covered crystal tree, is shown. The man holds the base up to his face, looking directly into the camera with a subtle smile, showing off the finished result.
